theory_reference: Asymmetric floor plus two nonparallel finite walls; no exact continuous rigid-motion symmetry is intended. Do not infer a single weak axis from the measured spectrum.
Ideal uniform infinite z-normal plane is invariant to in-plane translation and rotation about its normal; the finite sampled plane approximates those symmetries.
Longitudinally extruded left/right walls and floor are invariant to translation along +x in the ideal infinite corridor; floor and asymmetric cross-section are intended to constrain rotations.

Repeated circular cross-section along +x is invariant to longitudinal translation and rotation about its axis in the ideal infinite tunnel; finite ends and angular sampling approximate the symmetries.
